title: Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Chemical dosing pump impeller (Grade 5) requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by chemical dosing pump impeller (grade 5) and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining from plate for pump geometry
TIG welding all-position at 200W fiber laser
Passivation DI rinse at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for chemical dosing pump application
commonFailures: Weld zone preferential attack in chlorinated water - controlled by post-weld pickling and proper filler selection — critical for chemical dosing pump performance

faq.q: What pH range can Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller withstand in effluent streams?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains corrosion rates below 0.05 mm/year across pH 2-12 at 40°C in chloride-containing effluents. For chemical dosing pump handling acidic or alkaline waste streams, titanium eliminates the need for polymer linings or acid-resistant brick, reducing maintenance costs by approximately 60% over the 10-year design life.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller?
faq.a: Each Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for chemical dosing pump.
